RimSynapse - Psychology Official Wiki and Documentation: https://github.com/RimSynapse/Psychology/wiki
Companion Mod for RimSynapse. Requires RimSynapse - Core. Brings your colonists to life by giving them evolving memories, complex interpersonal trust, therapeutic sessions, and trauma responses.
--- Current Features --- - Dynamic Personality Traits: The nightly psychological evaluation tracks profound life events. Pawns can dynamically gain or lose RimWorld traits (such as gaining Bloodlust after a brutal raid, or losing Kind) based on LLM analysis of their rolling short-term memory. Cadence is adjustable in mod settings, from nightly up to every 7 days. - Trust and Familiarity System: Replaces vanilla's rigid opinion system with dynamic Trust (-100 to 100) and Familiarity (0 to 100) values. By default vanilla OpinionOf is scaled down by 50%, with the custom Trust metric contributing the remaining 50% weight - the blend is a slider. - Trauma, Despair and Mania: Three mental breaks vanilla does not have. A "Trauma Trigger" break has a pawn blindly firing at doors, walls or loud noises before cowering. A "Suicide/Self-Harm" break uses their equipped primary weapon against critical organs (5x damage by default, adjustable). And a pawn riding an extreme high - through bipolar, or a manic swing after a recent crash - can tip into "Euphoric (Reckless)" behaviour. - Therapy and Consoling: Right-click target pawns to initiate a Therapy Session. The therapist and patient will sit together and dynamically converse via the background LLM engine. Successful sessions have a dynamic chance (influenced by mood) to permanently cure/remove severe negative and psychological traits (including PTSD, Depressive, Pessimist, Volatile, Nervous, Psychopath, and Bloodlust - unless locked by their backstory). - Good Years Get Recorded: Good times are not just the absence of bad ones. A pawn who holds their mood at or above 85% for a sustained 24 in-game hours has the stretch picked up and queued for a psychological review, so it is written into their history alongside the hard years. - Ritual Remarks: Colonists pull from their LLM relationship memories to deliver personalized Vows during marriages and Eulogies during funerals. - Forced Psychological Reviews: Demand an immediate clinical evaluation of the pawn's mental state from the LLM via the new Social Network tab. - World VIP Backstories: Faction Leaders are no longer generic. They generate with a rich, ideologically consistent history and personality profile.
--- Planned Upcoming Features --- - Couples Counseling and Dynamic Romance: Breakups and romances driven entirely by shared memories and psychological compatibility rather than RNG. - LLM-Generated Phobias: Pawns who suffer specific traumas (e.g., severe burns, insectoid attacks) may develop targeted phobias that alter their pathing and combat behavior. - Group Therapy: Let your highest-social pawn lead group sessions to mass-resolve colony-wide trauma after devastating events. - Psychological Addictions: Pawns may turn to specific drugs as a coping mechanism for specific negative memories.
--- Roadmap --- 0.10.0 - Living Societies: SHIPPING NOW as a release candidate (see changelog below). 0.11.0 - Social Network Visualization: the Social Network tab becomes a colony-wide graph of trust and familiarity - one node per colonist, edges coloured by the relationship, and cliques drawn out as groups. These ship when they are ready - no dates.
--- Changelog (v0.10.0-rc1) - Living Societies (Release Candidate) --- - RELEASE CANDIDATE: 0.10.0 is feature-complete and in testing. Please report anything you find on GitHub or Discord before the final 0.10.0. - NEW - Relationship Compass: relationships are now two axes - Warmth (do they like each other?) and Trust (do they rely on each other?), each -100 to 100 - seeded by personality compatibility and moved by what colonists actually do together, not by chit-chat volume. Friendship AND rivalry milestones fire on both axes (so two colonists who only trade insults never become "best friends"), with reconciliation letters when old enemies make peace. Adds an emotional-brake "compulsion control", a nightly relationship evaluation, and an ideology-driven befriend -> convert -> recruit loop. - NEW - Therapy is treatment, not a coin flip: psychological struggles are now treatable conditions (Trauma/PTSD, Depression, Anxiety, Bipolar, Neurotic) cleared over repeated sessions with a weighted quality score - therapist Social skill, the patient's own bedroom, trust, and how reachable they are - held in the patient's bedroom rather than a hospital bed. Untreated conditions worsen and break more often. Pyromania is chronic (managed, never cured); Grief arises when someone close dies and eases with time or therapy. Three session modes: Guiding Hand, Watch, and Resolve in Background. - NEW - Colony Cliques: emergent friend-groups form from who your colonists are genuinely warm and familiar with, and feed into their dialogue and evaluations. - NEW - Trait History Timeline and richer leaders: every trait gained or lost is dated with the reasoning behind it; visitor and world-leader backstories take in outside faction context, with a new leadership "reports-to" hook for future faction hierarchies. - Fixed - the euphoria trait hook is data-driven: any trait can opt into the euphoric-reckless path instead of the game hardcoding bipolar. - Requires the latest RimSynapse Core.
Full version history: https://github.com/RimSynapse/Psychology/wiki/Changelog
--- Compatibility Matrix --- - Royalty DLC: Compatible and Optional. Integrates memories of nobility and royal power. - Ideology DLC: Compatible and Optional. Integrates crises of faith and spiritual rebirth memories. Required for deep Faction Leader generation. - Biotech DLC: Compatible and Optional. Integrates genetic dysphoria and vat-grown trauma. - Anomaly DLC: Compatible and Optional. Integrates void taint and cosmic horror PTSD. - RimSynapse - Factions: Compatible and Optional. Empowers world generation to build deep psychological profiles and traits for Faction Leaders. - RimSynapse - Chat: Compatible and Optional. Colonists' generated dialogue will be directly influenced by their current Trust levels, Familiarity, and accumulated traumas. - RimSynapse - WorldNews: Compatible and Optional. Prints gossip and news articles about your pawns' most dramatic psychological events and relationships.
--- Requirements --- - RimSynapse - Core (Must be loaded before this mod)
